concerns.description: Lists converted incorrectly
concerns.analysis: There is a list conversion error where a footnote marker was mistakenly interpreted as a bullet point. At the bottom of Table 2, a list of footnotes begins. The footnote starting with a single asterisk ('*Piped Natural Gas Tax') was converted into an unordered list item, while the subsequent footnotes using multiple asterisks ('**Real Estate', '***White Goods') or daggers ('†Scrap Tire') were formatted as standard paragraphs. This breaks the structural consistency of the footnote list.
